name: How should I prepare my house before interior remodeling begins?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my house before interior remodeling begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before workers arrive for demolition or remodeling, you should clear all personal belongings, fragile decor, and furniture from the work area. Establish a clear path from the exterior entry door to the remodel space so crews can safely haul tools and materials. If your project involves a kitchen or primary bathroom, arrange a temporary setup in an adjacent room for daily tasks. Taking photos of existing conditions and discussing work hours, material staging locations, and pet containment with your contractor ahead of time ensures a smooth, organized start.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear personal belongings and furniture from the work zone, set up temporary living spaces if needed, and secure pets before demolition and material delivery begin.
